page_title: ROM 3-0 PIS | AS Roma v Pisa 10/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
90+1' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Angelino (AS Roma) blazes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mile Svilar.
85' Substitution. Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) in, Devyne Rensch out.
84' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to make a change. Francesco Coppola (Pisa) replaces Arturo Calabresi.

82' That didn't go as planned! Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Mile Svilar, who easily kept it out.
80' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zeki Celik trots off the pitch and is replaced by Angelino (AS Roma).
78' It is time for a substitution. Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) is on for Donyell Malen.
77' The attendance is 60075.
74' Oscar Hiljemark prepares a substitution. Stefano Moreo is replaced by Felipe Loyola (Pisa).
74' That will be all from Matteo Tramoni who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa).
72' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
70' The ball is cleared after Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa.

67' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Pisa as they win a corner.
65' Here comes a substitution. Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Matias Soule.
63' Ermano Feliciani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.
62' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
59' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) meets the free kick and unleashes a header from the edge of the box, but it's not powerful enough to trouble Mile Svilar.
58' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
54' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Idrissa Toure and he is replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
54' Substitution. Malthe Hojholt leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa).
52' 3 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Matias Soule sets up Donyell Malen (AS Roma) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
51' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
50' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Zeki Celik (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
48' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Mile Svilar.
48' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
46' Lorenzo Pellegrini goes off the pitch and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45+1' Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Michel Aebischer (Pisa).
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Devyne Rensch plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Donyell Malen (AS Roma). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
42' OFF THE BAR! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
39' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
36' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
31' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
29' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and it's Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation.
24' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
21' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
21' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ermano Feliciani didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
19' Matias Soule (AS Roma) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
18' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
15' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
15' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
14' A cross into the box from Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is cleared. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Samuele Angori (Pisa) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
11' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
8' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
6' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
3' 1 - 0 Donyell Malen (AS Roma) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Adrian Semper with a strike under the crossbar. He makes it 1:0.
2' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
